subject: Hospitality
title: Seasonality and Its Traps
description: A quick win: understand Seasonality and Its Traps.

hook.text: Beach resorts peak in summer, ski resorts in winter, business hotels on weekdays. Seasonality defines hospitality economics.

buildup.text: During peak season, prices are high and rooms are full. Off-season, hotels slash rates and still struggle to fill beds.

discovery.text: Smart hotels create 'shoulder season' packages to extend demand beyond peak. Conferences in beach towns in autumn, for example.

twist.text: Climate change is shifting traditional seasons. European cities see summer tourism moving to spring and fall due to extreme heat.

climax.text: Revenue managers plan a full year ahead, adjusting budgets and staffing for the seasonal roller coaster they know is coming.

punchline.text: Boom months fund the slow ones. Seasonality is hospitality's heartbeat.

quiz.question: What is a 'shoulder season' strategy?
options: Closing the hotel in off-peak months
Creating packages to extend demand into periods between peak and off-season
